Every requirement in the plan follows from a behaviour or acceptance criterion in the specs I read. The deterministic checks passed for the criteria that have one.

**Criterion 8 (ts-plan-spec).** I opened `independent-review.spec.md`, `review-findings.spec.md`, `pull-request-description.spec.md` and `code-join.spec.md`. I did not open `overview.spec.md`, `session-record-checks.spec.md` or `reruns-and-feedback.spec.md`. No requirement contradicts a behaviour, and none goes beyond every behaviour. The two decision records and `session-record-checks.spec.md` were not opened.
- R1 follows from IRV-B1, "WHEN a run outside the quick lane passes the code step THE workflow SHALL run the review before the outcome gate". It also follows from IRV-B2, "go on to the outcome gate with no review".
- R2 follows from IRV-B3, "hand it the change since the run's base commit, with no hand-over document in it", and IRV-B4, "numbered as the triage note numbers them".
- R3 follows from IRV-B5, "keep out of it, and out of each value it reads, the text of the plan, the hand-off, the code report".
- R4 follows from IRV-B6, "fail its check, naming the document", and IRV-B7, "fail its check, naming the file".
- R5 follows from RVF-B2 to RVF-B5. RVF-B3 reads "fail its check, naming the finding's number", and RVF-B5 reads "the single word `None`".
- R6 follows from IRV-B8, "mark a finding blocking only when a person… would meet the defect as a wrong or missing result".
- R7 follows from IRV-B9, IRV-B10 and IRV-B11. IRV-B10 reads "whatever the other blocking findings name".
- R8 follows from IRV-B12, "send it back no second time", and IRV-B13, "pause the run, with each blocking finding left shown".
- R9 follows from IRV-B14 and IRV-AC9, "a planted defect… sent back by the review to the code step".
- R10 follows from PRD-B9 and PRD-AC9, "lists findings 2 and 3… after `Read these`".
- R11 follows from PRD-B1 to PRD-B8 and PRD-AC1 to PRD-AC8. The plan's Spec ids cell lists them.
- R12 follows from RVF-B6 and RVF-B7, "`Visit: built`… `Visit: refused`".
- R13 follows from triage AC10 and IRV-B1. Only the first part, that the unit appears in the overview and README, is tied to a behaviour. The `outcome.json` revision and the `author verify` run come from the task's own criterion, not from a behaviour.

`code-join.spec.md` was already edited. It says "the run goes on from it to the independent review, or straight to the outcome gate", which matches the plan's route design.
